final_claim: If \(\operatorname{stick}(K)=2b(K)+2\), then trefoil summation raises stick number by exactly two per trefoil; more generally, two bridge-bound-saturating factors attain the four-stick connected-sum saving when one minimum polygon has an external edge.
limitations: The general two-factor equality requires an external-edge minimum polygon for one factor.
